# Seekerville

> > A vibrant community blog for Christian fiction and inspirational romance writers, featuring author profiles, writing craft advice, and fellowship from award-winning novelists.

Seekerville is a collaborative author community blog founded by Mary Connealy, Janet Dean, and Debby Giusti, dedicated to supporting writers of Christian fiction and inspirational romance. The site serves as a hub for writing advice, community events, and spiritual encouragement for both aspiring and published authors.

## Key Topics

- Christian fiction
- Inspirational romance
- Writing craft and advice
- Author community
- Writing persistence
- Story structure
- Seekerville founders
- Carol Award
- Rita Award
- Christy Award
- Prayer and scripture
- Community fellowship
- Blogging journey
- Monthly events
- Social media

## Community Hub

- [Homepage](https://seekerville.blogspot.com): Main entry point for Seekerville inspirational romance writer community
- [About & Contact Us](https://seekerville.blogspot.com/p/about-contact.html): About Seekerville community and contact information for inquiries
- [Our Bloggers](https://seekerville.blogspot.com/p/the-seekerville-bloggers.html): Profiles of Christian fiction authors and award-winning romance writers
- [Founders](https://seekerville.blogspot.com/p/founders.html): Information about Seekerville founders Mary Connealy, Janet Dean, Debby Giusti

## Events & Calendar

- [Calendar](https://seekerville.blogspot.com/p/calendar.html): Event calendar and monthly schedule for Seekerville community

## Writing Craft & Advice

- [Five Ways NOT to Start a Story](https://seekerville.blogspot.com/2023/06/five-ways-not-to-start-story.html): Writing craft guide on common story opening mistakes and narrative structure
- [Learning Persistence from Taylor Swift](https://seekerville.blogspot.com/2023/06/learning-persistence-from-taylor-swift.html): Writing advice on persistence and overcoming procrastination for authors

## Community & Devotional

- [Sunday Scripture & Prayer Requests](https://seekerville.blogspot.com/2023/06/sunday-scripture-prayer-requests_0487284189.html): Weekly scripture devotional and community prayer request thread

- [Good Night Sweet Blog](https://seekerville.blogspot.com/2023/06/good-night-sweet-blog.html): Farewell post reflecting on Seekerville's legacy and writing community impact
